about_the_game:
Step into Landiscape, where every moment is a fierce struggle for survival! Start off in a slow and safe area and expand into dangerous enemy infested areas who all want to take you down. The more you wish to discover and unlock, the harder it will be to survive.

In Landiscape, you’re not just fighting to survive—you’re fighting to become the ultimate ruler of the land. Engage in relentless battles against cunning adversaries and formidable enemies who will stop at nothing to challenge your supremacy. Scavenge for valuable resources, build and fortify your base, and prepare for epic showdowns that will test your strategic prowess and combat skills.

  • Base building/Crafting system

  • Wide range of weapons

  • Pleasing to watch Stylized PBR Graphics

  • Largely expanding updates to come

  • Multiplayer and Large Servers to come

  • Swim, mine, explore, craft, plant, etc.

content_descriptors.notes: Guns used in battle, players fighting other players using guns, explosives, weapons.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3225 3.3 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7300U 3.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7870 equivalent DX11 GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
